Message:
Nrgh... Mm...it’s so bright...
Is that you, Mother...?

When my puffy eyes
finally focused,
I saw a group of
unfamiliar witches
standing before me.

“It seems that
this little witch survived.”
“Little witch”...?

Following their eyes,
I suddenly saw several objects
floating in the air beside me.
They were...
A brooch.
A parasol.
A pocket watch.
A ribbon.

Each object,
having lost its master,
seemed to be calling out to me...

We wanted to protect you.
We wanted to be with you longer.

These...were my
mother and sisters’...!

“There’s no need to shed
any tears for traitors
who defend humans.

If you have any pride as a witch,
lift your head.

Us witches are the chosen ones,
after all.”

The chosen ones...?
...Don’t make me laugh.

A black, hot something...
began to bubble up within me...

...Ah, yes...
This must be
what they call, “hatred”...

I want to destroy them...
Each and every one of
these witches before me...!

Suddenly, my sister’s parasol
popped open without a sound.

The white lace
obstructed my view,
its handle facing towards me.

As though it were
shielding my eyes from evil,
and prompting me to walk
the path that was right...

“My dear sister, I do apologize.
That was far too hasty
for a lady, wasn’t it?

But, don’t you find
all that talk of
‘taking pride as a witch’
simply dreadful?”

“For them not to realize
they’re no different from
those witch-hunting humans...
It’s so laughable, it’s pathetic.”

I grasped the parasol’s handle,
and turned to walk away.
The rain had lifted,
and I kept walking
beneath the clear sky.

I’ll prove them wrong.
I’ll make a world where witches
and humans can coexist,

and I’ll make them admit
that my mother
and sisters were right.

It would be my honor to lay
the foundation for such a world.

Only then will I
be a great witch...

No... Only then will I
take pride in being great.

So, Mother, sisters...
Please, stay by my side,
and watch over me...
